content.value: A rectangular beam that must. carry a service live load of 2.5 kips/ft and a calculated dead load of 1.25 kips/ft on an 22 ft simple span is limited in cross section for architectural reasons to 12 inch width and 22 inch total depth. It is reinforced for compression bars in one row, the center of which is 2.5 inch from upper surface of the beam, and for tension with bars in two rows, the center of the lowers row being 2.5 inch above the lower surface of the beam. If $f _ { y } = 6 0 { , } 0 0 0$ psi and $f _ { c } ^ { \prime } = 3 5 0 0$ psi, what steel areas must be provided? Design the beam by USD method and show reinforcement details.
